description: Brussels Regional Cycle Routes is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Brussels Mobilité - Mobiliteit  - Mobility . Regional cycle routes are recommended routes for medium and long distance bicycle journeys through several municipalities. As a general rule, these routes use local roads, where traffic is less dense, slower, and therefore less stressful than on the main roads. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence (terms as labelled on the portal, not read).
